steamify.options.title: Controller Settings
steamify.haptic.mining.tooltip: A faint tick at each crack stage while breaking a block
steamify.haptic.fishing.tooltip: A buzz the moment a fish takes the bait
steamify.haptic.explosion.tooltip: Rumble from nearby explosions, stronger the closer they are
steamify.haptic.thunder.tooltip: Rumble when lightning strikes, stronger the closer it is
steamify.haptic.bow.tooltip: Ticks that quicken as a bow draws and a click at full draw. Also clicks when a crossbow loads or a trident is ready
steamify.haptic.shield.tooltip: A thud when your shield stops a hit
steamify.haptic.heartbeat.tooltip: A heartbeat at 3 hearts and below, faster the lower you go
steamify.haptic.trigger.tooltip: Pulling a trigger past its click point
steamify.haptic.rightPad.tooltip: Light ticks while your thumb moves on the right trackpad
steamify.haptic.hotbar.tooltip: A tick each time the left trackpad picks a new hotbar slot
steamify.haptic.footsteps.tooltip: Each step on the ground, alternating left and right
steamify.haptic.damage.tooltip: Taking damage, harder the bigger the hit
steamify.haptic.landing.tooltip: Hitting the ground after a fall, stronger the further you fell
steamify.haptic.flight.tooltip: Low wind rumble while gliding or flying, pulsing faster the faster you go
steamify.haptic.falling.tooltip: Sharp rattle while falling, faster the faster you fall
steamify.calibrate.title: Calibrate Gyro
steamify.calibrate.hint: Put the controller down on a flat surface and don't touch it
steamify.calibrate.waiting: Waiting for the controller to be still...
steamify.calibrate.noGyro: No controller with a gyro connected
steamify.calibrate.button.tooltip: Measures the gyro's resting drift with the controller lying still. Redo it if aiming drifts or slow turns feel off
steamify.calibrate.prompt.title: Calibrate your gyro?
steamify.calibrate.prompt: Gyro aiming feels best once the controller has been calibrated. It takes a few seconds with the controller lying on a flat surface.
steamify.options.sets.tooltip: Extra layers of controller binds, switched on by a button, a grip, a stick touch or a stick pushed to its edge
steamify.sets.title: Action Sets
steamify.sets.add.tooltip: A layer of binds on top of the normal ones. It only changes the binds you set in it
steamify.sets.name: Name
steamify.sets.trigger.tooltip: Click, then press the button or combo, touch a grip or stick, or push a stick to its edge. Already holding a grip? Let go and touch it again. Hold B for a second to cancel. Right-click (or LT) to pick from a list
steamify.sets.enter.tooltip: Pressed once when the set switches on
steamify.sets.enter.title: %s: On Enter
steamify.sets.exit.tooltip: Pressed once when the set switches off
steamify.sets.exit.title: %s: On Exit
steamify.sets.hold.tooltip: Held down the whole time the set is on, and let go when it switches off. E.g. a zoom key, on a set triggered by R5
steamify.sets.hold.title: %s: Hold While On
steamify.sets.mode.tooltip: Hold: on while the trigger is held. Toggle: each press switches it. While Released: on while the trigger is NOT held, e.g. letting go of a grip
steamify.sets.where.tooltip: In Menus: the set's binds work on menu screens like the inventory, over the normal menu controls on the buttons they use. Handy for a mod's inventory keys
steamify.sets.places.tooltip: Click while in a singleplayer world or on a server to add it, again to remove it. From the title screen: clear. With worlds set, the set is only on there. With no trigger or items, it's always on there
steamify.sets.gyro.tooltip: Gyro while this set is on. Unchanged leaves it to the sets below, normally on while the right pad is touched
steamify.battery.low.title: Controller battery low
steamify.sets.items.tooltip: Click while holding an item to add it, again to remove it. With an empty hand: clear. With items set, the set is only on while you hold one of them (and its button trigger, if it has one, is active)
steamify.sets.tunes.tooltip: Stick, pad and gyro speed, deadzone, Steady Aim and aim assist while this set is on
steamify.sets.tunes.title: %s: Sensitivity
steamify.sets.tunes.slider.tooltip: All the way left: unchanged, the normal Controller Settings value applies
steamify.sets.binds.tooltip: Controls screen for this set. Grey binds come from the normal layout. Escape to unbind in this set, Backspace to go back to the normal bind
steamify.sets.editing: Editing action set: %s  (Escape to unbind, Backspace to use the normal bind)
steamify.option.hotbar.strip.tooltip: OFF: a 3x3 grid in the middle of the screen, slots 1-3 on the top row. ON: the pad's width maps to the hotbar, left edge slot 1, right edge slot 9
steamify.option.hotbar.gridSpot.tooltip: Center: the grid pops up while the left pad is touched. A corner: the grid stays there in place of the normal hotbar. Not used with Strip Layout
steamify.debug.title: Debug Shortcuts
steamify.option.look.stickSpeed.tooltip: How fast the right stick turns the camera
steamify.option.look.padSpeed.tooltip: How far the camera turns per swipe on the right trackpad
steamify.option.look.gyro.tooltip: Camera rotation per controller rotation. 1.0x turns the camera exactly as far as you turn the controller
steamify.option.look.stickDeadzone.toolt: How far a stick must move before it counts. Raise it if the camera or player drifts on its own
steamify.option.menu.cursorSpeed.tooltip: How fast the right stick and trackpad move the cursor in menus
steamify.option.look.invertY.tooltip: Flips up and down for stick, trackpad and gyro camera control
steamify.option.gyro.steadyAim.tooltip: Lowers gyro sensitivity while drawing a bow, charging a crossbow, readying a trident, using a spyglass or holding a loaded crossbow
How much Steady Aim lowers gyro sensitivity
steamify.option.aim.assist.tooltip: Slows turning while your crosshair is on a mob in reach and gently pulls toward it while you steer. Controller only, never affects the mouse
steamify.option.aim.assistStrength.toolt: How strongly aim assist slows and pulls
steamify.option.aim.assistSingleplayerOn: Turns aim assist off on servers and LAN worlds
steamify.onboard.title: Steamify Setup
steamify.onboard.page1: This can be changed later in settings
steamify.onboard.page2: Gyro aiming feels best once the controller has been calibrated. It takes a few seconds with the controller lying on a flat surface.
steamify.onboard.gyro.none: This controller has no gyro, so there's nothing to calibrate
steamify.option.haptics.master.tooltip: Scales every haptic effect at once. The individual sliders below set each effect relative to this
steamify.onboard.page3: Try the right stick, the right trackpad, and the gyro while your thumb rests on the trackpad
steamify.onboard.page4: Which layouts should the on-screen keyboard switch between?
steamify.bind.tooltip: Click, then press a button or combo, push a stick to its edge or swipe a trackpad. Right-click (or LT) to pick long press, double press and other press types
steamify.bind.title: %s: Controller Binds
steamify.bind.combo.tooltip: Click, then press the new button or combo, push a stick to its edge or swipe a trackpad. Right-click (or LT) to pick from a list. Escape to remove this bind
steamify.gesture.regular.tooltip: On for as long as you hold the buttons
steamify.gesture.short.tooltip: Taps when you let go before the long press time. Pair it with a Long Press on the same buttons to give them two actions
steamify.gesture.long.tooltip: Turns on once you've held for the long press time, and stays on until you let go
steamify.gesture.double.tooltip: Turns on with a quick second press and stays on while you hold it. A Short Press on the same buttons waits out the double press time first
steamify.gesture.start.tooltip: Taps the moment you press, even when the same buttons also have a long or double press
steamify.gesture.release.tooltip: Taps when you let go, however long you held
steamify.option.binds.longPress.tooltip: How long to hold for a Long Press. Letting go sooner counts as a Short Press
steamify.option.binds.doublePress.toolti: How soon the second press of a Double Press has to come
steamify.option.binds.stickEdge.tooltip: How far a stick has to be pushed for its edge inputs (L Stick Up, L Stick Edge...), from the center (0%%) to all the way (100%%)
steamify.option.binds.padEdge.tooltip: How far from the center your finger has to be for a trackpad's edge inputs (L Pad Up, L Pad Edge...)
steamify.option.binds.swipeStep.tooltip: How far your finger travels per press of a swipe input (L Pad Swipe Up...), in percent of the pad's width. Lower scrolls faster
steamify.steam.toast.body: May cause double inputs. Close Steam.
steamify.steam.warning: Steam is running: its controller layout may double your inputs
steamify.steam.warning.fix: Close Steam while playing with Steamify
steamify.picker.hint: Pick one, or several to hold together
steamify.profiles.title: Profiles
steamify.profiles.button.tooltip: Whole setups to switch between with one click: binds, action sets and these settings. Each controller remembers the profile you last used with it and switches back to it when it connects. Gyro calibration is shared by all of them
steamify.profiles.add.tooltip: Adds a copy of the current profile to the list. Click it to switch to it
steamify.option.look.padFriction.tooltip: How quickly a flick on the right trackpad spins down. Higher stops sooner
steamify.share.invalid: The clipboard doesn't hold anything copied from Steamify
steamify.profiles.copy.tooltip: Copies this profile to the clipboard as one line of text to share. Gyro calibration isn't included, but world names and server addresses in its action sets are
steamify.profiles.paste.tooltip: Adds a profile from text copied with Copy, and switches to it
steamify.sets.copy.tooltip: Copies this set to the clipboard as one line of text to share
steamify.sets.paste.tooltip: Adds a set from text copied with Copy Set
steamify.profiles.name.tooltip: Name of the active profile (the highlighted one)
steamify.profiles.lock.tooltip: Keeps the controller you're using tied to this profile. Switching profiles still works, but the controller comes back to this one the next time you pick it up
steamify.option.gyro.playerSpace.tooltip: ON: turning left and right follows the horizon however you hold the controller, so yawing or rolling it both turn (Steam's Player Space). OFF: only rotating the controller around its own up axis turns
